title: Rules and Responsibilities Quiz
description: Let's see what you learned about being a good helper and following rules!

questions.question: Why do we have rules?
options: To keep us safe and help us get along
questions.explanation: Rules help keep us safe and help us get along with each other! God gave us rules because He loves us.

questions.question: What is one way to be a helper at home?
questions.explanation: Picking up your toys is a great way to help at home! God is happy when we serve our family.

questions.question: Who are community helpers?
questions.explanation: Firefighters, police officers, and doctors are all community helpers! God gives them special gifts to serve others.

questions.question: What is the Golden Rule?
options: Treat others the way you want to be treated
questions.explanation: The Golden Rule says 'Do to others what you would have them do to you' (Matthew 7:12). Treat others the way you want to be treated!

questions.question: What makes God happy?
questions.explanation: God is happy when we are kind and help others! Being a good helper shows God's love to everyone around us.
